short_title: You pass 2nd place. What place are you? 🧠 #shorts
short_description:
Quick brain test: you're running a race and you pass the person in second place. What place are you in now? Your instinct may say "first"… but you only took second place's spot!

Bonus: what happens if you pass the LAST person? Comment your answer 👇

Think fast. Learn something amazing. Synthetic voice, original illustrations.

#shorts #brainteaser #riddle #quiz #logic #factora
